reason: A sheet policy evaluated on single-image primary development is only a high-resolution native-image policy; it switches to an unvalidated contact sheet for multi-image transfer. Preserve original results and test a fixed support gate separately.
rule: Use the predeclared baseline for a multi-image input when the selected policy uses a sheet layout but that objective has no multi-image example in primary development. Otherwise use the original optimized route.
selection_inputs: Primary development view counts and already-frozen selected policy only; inference branch uses number of input views, never source identity, target or test performance.
calibration: Use the original baseline or optimized primary-development cutoff for the selected branch; source-development cutoffs remain secondary. Report branch-specific cutoffs explicitly.
inference: No new model forwards; reuse unchanged baseline/optimized predictions.
qualification: Retrospective E2B correction designed after its transfer regression was seen; other models retain their original primary runs. It is a diagnostic method improvement, not a new untouched acceptance test.
